## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Verification

List the commands run and their results. For model behavior claims, include the dataset split, model snapshot, held-out metrics, controls, and observed limits.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests or direct checks relevant to this change passed.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the behavior.
- [ ] No model weights, credentials, private datasets, or run outputs were added.
- [ ] Security-sensitive details are reported privately.
